section.title: How It Works
section.description: Promo orders are facilitated from product selection, through artwork approval, to customer in-hand with a focus on quality products, affordable prices, and quick turnarounds to ensure your team can place orders with the confidence they'll arrive on time and as expected.

steps.title: Select
steps.description: Browse our catalog at broadstrokepromos.com or visit our onsite Promo Showroom to view products in person. Team members provide expert recommendations based on your preferences and budget.

steps.title: Customize
steps.description: Our design team creates or refines your artwork. We provide proofs showing brand or personalization placement before production begins. Sample orders available to ensure quality standards and color matches.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.description: Most promotional products ship directly to you from our trusted vendors. Apparel orders are inspected by our team before delivery. Rush options available to meet tight deadlines.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for promotional items?
faqs.a: Minimum order quantities vary by product type. Some items are available with no minimums and can be personalized for your recipient! Apparel typically requires 12-24 pieces, and many items start at 24-50 pieces. Screen-printed apparel has a minimum order quantity of 24; embroidery has no minimum. Some premium gifts and tech items may have higher minimums. Contact us at promoinfo@broadstrokeinc.com for specific product details—we can help you find options that fit your budget and quantity needs.

We offer multiple customization methods to match your product and design: screen printing and embroidery for apparel; laser engraving for metal and wood items; debossing and embossing for leather and premium products; full-color digital printing for complex designs; and pad printing for pens and small items. Our team recommends the best method for your specific project.

faqs.q: How long does it take to receive promotional products?
faqs.a: Standard production time is typically 2-3 weeks after artwork approval (including shipping time). Rush production is available for many products (additional fees may apply). Around the holidays, it's best to order 1-2 months ahead to ensure availability and on-time delivery. Complex orders or large quantities may require additional time. We'll provide a clear timeline when you request your estimate.

faqs.q: Can you help with product selection and design?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Our team provides product recommendations based on your goals, budget, and timeline. In-house designers create or refine your artwork to ensure optimal customization results. Whether you have existing brand guidelines or need creative development, we handle every detail to deliver impactful branded merchandise.

faqs.q: Do you offer fulfillment and shipping services?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide complete fulfillment services including kitting, custom packaging, and shipping to multiple locations. Promotional products can be integrated with print and mail campaigns for cohesive marketing initiatives. Store and release programs are also available for ongoing employee or client gifting needs.

faqs.q: What is the process for obtaining a free estimate?
faqs.a: Submit your details by email to promoinfo@broadstrokeinc.com, or call 316-247-5348. You can also submit your details through our contact form. A member of our team will review your project and provide a clear, no-obligation estimate with recommended products, branding and personalization options, and timelines. For promo, the email address and phone number are the most direct ways to get straight to our promo team.
